# SmartStay

> SmartStay is a digital guest guide and guest communication platform for apartment hosts and hotels. Guests open one link or QR code on their phone (no app install) and find Wi-Fi, check-in instructions, house rules, local recommendations and an AI assistant that answers in their language, 24/7. Available in Bosnian and English; guides support 5 languages.

## Product
- [Apartments (BS)](https://smartstay.ba/apartmani/): digital guide for apartment hosts — Wi-Fi, check-in, house rules, recommendations, upsells, AI assistant, guest registration. From 5.99 KM per property per month, free trial.
- [Hotels (BS)](https://smartstay.ba/hoteli/): guest communication platform for hotels — reception requests, room service, extra services, bookings, announcements to all guests, reception dashboard by room. Packages from 59 KM per month.
- [Apartments (EN)](https://smartstay.ba/en/apartments/)
- [Hotels (EN)](https://smartstay.ba/en/hotels/)
